summary: Tested new 'Generar autorización' feature in TasacionesScreen (both manual tasador and online-leads inbox). Backend property creation, navigation to /documentos/nuevo, and pre-selection of the PROPERTY in the wizard all work correctly. HOWEVER a critical business-logic bug prevents the PERSON (owner) from being pre-selected: the frontend passes prefillPersonRole='vendedor' but the 'Autorización de Venta' template requires role='propietario'. Result: on the Personas step the Propietario selector is empty and the wizard cannot advance (Siguiente disabled), defeating the whole purpose of the one-click feature.

integration_issues.issue: TasacionesScreen.tsx hardcodes prefillPersonRole='vendedor' in BOTH generarAutorizacion() (line 158) and generarAutorizacionLead() (line 182). The Autorización de Venta template (templateKey='autorizacion_venta') declares its person variables with role='propietario' (verified via GET /api/documents/templates/{id}). DocumentWizard initializes personsByRole = {[prefillPersonRole]: [prefillPersonId]}, so the owner ends up under 'vendedor' key while the wizard's Personas step only shows/needs 'propietario'. The Propietario selector renders empty, and the Siguiente button on step 3 is disabled — user must manually pick the owner they just typed 5 seconds earlier, which is exactly what the feature was supposed to avoid.

action_items: FIX (one-line, both places): change `prefillPersonRole: 'vendedor'` → `prefillPersonRole: 'propietario'` in /app/frontend/src/app/screens/TasacionesScreen.tsx lines 158 and 182. Consider also aligning the /api/people/resolve body role field ('vendedor') with the wizard role, or at least documenting that the person's storage role and the wizard role can differ.
Retest after fix: verify Personas step shows the owner (Juan QA Test / TEST_qa) already checked/selected for Propietario, and that Siguiente becomes enabled without any manual person picking.

QA credential note (unchanged from iteration_58): qa_varela@vera.test is employee-typed; I flipped isAdmin=true in Mongo app_access to reach /documentos and reverted it back to false after the test. Same recommendation stands: provision a permanent admin QA user or add the owner's admin creds for Documents-area testing.
critical_code_review_comments: The role mismatch bug above is symptomatic of a wider risk: the code assumes the template's owner role is 'vendedor', but templates control their own required roles. Safer approach: after the template loads in DocumentWizard, if prefillPersonId is present and no role is set (or the given role isn't among the template's required roles), auto-map the prefilled person into the FIRST person-typed variable's role (e.g. template.variables.find(v=>v.source==='person').role). That way the tasador screen doesn't need to know the template's internal role naming.

Both generarAutorizacion() and generarAutorizacionLead() swallow the propertyService.createProperty() error with a bare catch and only show a generic flash. If /api/people/resolve fails (manual flow) the created property would still succeed and orphan a draft property in the DB. Consider resolving the person first and only creating the property after person.id is confirmed (which is already the order in generarAutorizacion — good — but there's no verification that personRes.ok before reading .id).

areaM2 fallback in manual flow uses cubiertos-or-lote — for lotes this is wrong for casas (uses cubiertos even when it might be blank). For casa/duplex a saner default is cubiertos ? Number(cubiertos) : 0 and pass lotAreaM2 separately, which is already done. Low priority.

Validation flash correctly blocks navigation when propietario or telefono is empty. Regression: 'Guardar lead' (tas-lead) still shows its success flash; tas-jpg was not exercised (it triggers a client-side download — low risk, unrelated code path). After main agent's fix, just re-run the happy path once for each of the two entry points and verify Personas step shows the pre-selected owner and Siguiente is enabled.
rca of the issue: Root cause: hardcoded person role in TasacionesScreen.tsx does not match the Autorización de Venta template's variable role. Template declares role='propietario' for propietario_nombre & propietario_dni (backend GET /api/documents/templates/ba0e6d91-f96c-4d95-b069-70c612315d3e confirmed). TasacionesScreen passes 'vendedor'. DocumentWizard blindly trusts the prefill and stores personsByRole['vendedor'] = [id], which is never read by the Personas step that only looks up personsByRole['propietario']. Reproduction: Login → /veraos/tasaciones → fill manual form + Calcular → Generar autorización → pick 'Autorización de Venta' → advance to Personas step → observe empty Propietario selector and disabled Siguiente. Mitigation: change the string literal 'vendedor' → 'propietario' in the two navigate() calls; longer-term, make DocumentWizard smart enough to auto-place the prefilled personId into whichever role the template needs (see code review comment).
